placements.why: The envelope's entire content is an instrument calibration report — a value/frequency figure verified against a named reference standard. Nothing in the supplied strata (which is empty) covers this organizational category, and it is not a Strategy, Product, Architecture, Organization, Proof, or Templates concern; it names its own recurring organizational activity (instrument calibration work) that future envelopes will keep feeding, so it earns its own strata category rather than being forced under an unrelated one.
placements.title: Instrument calibration and verification as an organizational category
placements.frame: Does this content concern bringing an instrument to a verified operating state against a named reference standard, rather than the strategy, product, or architecture surrounding it?

placements.title: Calibration state is established by verification against a fixed reference, not by assertion alone
placements.frame: What reference standard was this instrument's calibration verified against, and does that verification still hold across the operating range claimed?
placements.why: All three segments converge on one thematic subject future calibration envelopes will keep feeding: an instrument's calibration value is only meaningful once verified against a named reference standard and shown to hold across its operating band. src-1 states this in prose ('verified the calibration against the June reference plates and it holds across the full observing band'); src-2 and src-3 restate the same claim as labelled fields naming the instrument and the calibration/verification pair. This is a directional statement about how calibration claims are grounded — true beyond these particular words — not a one-time fact, so it earns a leaf rather than being folded as a bare measurement into some other theme. The position pass's VerifiedCalibrationClaim grouping and the register pass's FlatTechnicalCataloguing mint both point at this same convergence from their own dimensions; this leaf is the content-grain home for it.
